name: Sensation XL

Network.Technology: GSM/GPRS/EDGE, 850 900 1800 1900 MHz, UMTS/HSPA, 850 1900 2100 or 900 1700 2100 MHz, HSDPA 14.4 Mbps, HSUPA 5.76 Mbps

Body.Other: USB and Wi-Fi tethering, HTC Sense v3.5

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.3.3 Gingerbread (upgradeable to 4.0), HTC Sense 3.0 overlay

Display.Display: 4.7 in LCD Gorilla glass touch screen with WVGA (480×800) resolution

Cameras.Rear camera: 8-megapixel (3264×2448) with autofocus and dual LED flash, 720p HD video recording @ 30 frame/s with tap-to-focus and digital zoom

Battery.Battery: 1600 mAh internal rechargeable li-ion , User replaceable

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm TRRS connector, Bluetooth 3.0 with A2DP, FM stereo receiver (87.5-108 MHz) with RDS, Micro USB 2.0 (5-pin) port with Mobile High-definition Link for USB or HDMI connection, Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n
